main.description: Create a reserved World from its unchanged PLC genesis signed by the owner's rotation key. Service auth must come from the reserving owner, addressed to this tenor's did:web service with #motet_tenor. Retry the same reservation and signed operation after an uncertain response; accepted creation intents retain their keys until completion.
